info.name: FinOps Enterprise — Complete Route Inventory
info.description: Generated from the backend route source available in the Nov 17, 2026 archive. Includes every Express route found there, reusable variables, basic response checks, and select example payloads. Not an exhaustive automated business-logic test suite. Mutating requests MUST be reviewed and should be run against a disposable development database; do not run full collection indiscriminately.
